title: Sutra Desktop app manifest (module.json)
description: The one record of an app. The folder ~/.sutra-ui/modules/<id>/ IS the app (D-M1); this file is its manifest and, under ADR-039, the unit that a marketplace publishes. schema = file format (1 = v1.0/v1.1 on disk, 2 = adds department + publish); version = app revision (integer, bumped on every mutation); publish.version = semver for distribution. Unknown fields are preserved on read and write (additionalProperties: true throughout).

id.description: equals the folder name; sys- prefix is reserved for system seeds and never stored

status.description: the LOCAL lifecycle (archive never deletes). Distribution lifecycle lives in publish.state (codex 2026-09-11 P2).

version.description: app revision; every mutation bumps it

surface.description: kind-specific: chat {instructions, cwd?} · page {entry: index.html} · link {screen, sections?}

guard.description: reserved; not enforced in v1.x (a non-empty guard renders a warning)

ref.description: ONLY the ref is persisted (D-M13, codex P6); path and name are re-resolved at read; an unknown ref reads as Unassigned, never the root

publish.description: absent or null until the app is exported or installed (ADR-039)

version.description: semver for distribution; independent of the integer revision

state.description: distribution lifecycle (APPS-LIFECYCLE.md); local is the default when publish is absent. failed_verification is NOT a manifest value: nothing lands on a refused import, so it exists only as app.imported.result in the events log (codex R1b P2)
